capabilities: Preview .qmd files live in a side pane while editing
Convert supported Quarto and Pandoc syntax to Obsidian-renderable Markdown or HTML
Run quarto render to check official HTML output
Export a shareable single-file HTML with inlined local images
Apply CSS from QMD frontmatter or _metadata.yml scoped to the preview pane
extras: Desktop only (Quarto CLI integration and local file access need desktop APIs). The plugin UI is currently Chinese. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Live preview never executes document code; manual Quarto render and HTML export can execute code and ask for confirmation.
motivation: Built for people who write Quarto Markdown but want Obsidian's editing workflow, backlinks, vault navigation, and fast local feedback.
problem: Obsidian does not natively render Quarto Markdown, so .qmd authors lack live writing feedback inside their vault workflow.

relations.evidence: The plugin calls quarto render, displays the generated HTML, and keeps it separate from the live preview mode.

summary: Side-pane live preview for Quarto Markdown (.qmd) files that converts supported QMD and Pandoc syntax into Obsidian-rendered Markdown or HTML.
